title: Series RLC reactance changes sign through resonance

checks.derivation: At ω0=1/sqrt(LC), reactive terms cancel and Z=R.
Inductor and capacitor reactances are equal and opposite.
sqrt(L/C)=.1 Ω; at half resonance X=.1(.5−2)=−.15 Ω.

evidence.provenance: First-principles network limits or algebraic reduction of the declared teaching loop, independent of production numerical output.

prediction: Does the capacitor branch remain capacitive above self-resonance?
explanation: No. The series branch is capacitive below resonance, resistive at resonance, and inductive above it.
limitations: Lumped series RLC; no bias, temperature, aging or distributed behavior.
This is a branch-level reference rather than a named-part capacitor model.
